## What we use and why

Cookies are small pieces of information a browser can store. Similar technologies include local or session storage, pixels and scripts that read device information. Some are needed for a service you request or for communication over the network. Others serve purposes such as statistics or marketing. The name of a technology does not decide whether consent is needed; its actual purpose and operation do.
